# Bubble
A rounded message surface for conversational content: chat, comments, assistant replies. Bubbles stack in a group, align to the sender's side and can carry a reaction chip on the bottom edge.

USE WHEN
• Showing one message in a conversation thread (human or assistant)
• Grouping consecutive messages from the same sender
• Attaching quick reactions to a message

DON'T USE WHEN
• The content is a status or system notice: use Alert
• The content is a short label or count: use Badge
• The content is a card, list row or long document: use Card or ListItem

DO
• Align your own messages to the end and others' to the start
• Use primary for the sender's own message and secondary or muted for replies
• Keep destructive for failed or error messages
• Give a link or button bubble a real link or button (asChild), not a click handler on a div

DON'T
• Stack more than one bubble variant per sender in a group
• Put interactive controls inside a non-interactive bubble

PROPERTIES
• Variant: primary | secondary | muted | tinted | outline | destructive. Secondary is background-muted, muted is background-subtle, tinted is primary-subtle
• Align: start | end. Both draw identically here; alignment is layout only (see Examples)
• Text: string, the message
Bubble Reaction is a separate component: an overlapping chip (background-muted, radius-full, 2px surface ring) positioned on the bubble's bottom edge; the offset is drawn in Examples.
